Trace, implement and test: leetcode013 leetcode13 roman to integer

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution:
    def romanToInt(self, s: str) -> int:
        d = dict()
        d = {
            'I': 1,
            'V': 5,
            'X': 10,
            'L': 50,
            'C': 100,
            'D': 500,
            'M': 1000
        }

        sum0 = 0
        for i in range(len(s)):
            currentValue = d[s[i]]
            
            if i == len(s) -1 or d[s[i+1]] <= currentValue:  # d[s[i+1]]: nextValue
                sum0 += d[s[i]]
            else:
                sum0 -= d[s[i]]
        
        return sum0

sol = Solution()
print(sol.romanToInt("MCMXCIV"))
